modules.name: Welcome to BUS230
modules.description:
Dear Students,

On behalf of myself and the teaching team, I would like to welcome you to "BUS230 - Change Management". My name is Dr. Kanwal Nasim, and I am the unit coordinator for this course.

You can download the Unit Outline from the link provided on the Learning Management System (LMS) site. I encourage you to explore the resources and links available on the LMS page to get familiar with the course materials.

Pre-workshop activities are posted on the LMS, and I ask that you complete these activities each week before attending the workshops.

The recommended textbook for this unit is "Sveningsson S., and Sörgärde N. 2023. Managing Change in Organizations. 2nd ed. SAGE Publications, London: UK. ISBN: 9781529798999".

All essential information can be found in the Unit Outline on the LMS unit web page.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to your teaching team via email (available in unit outline).

Kind regards,
Kanwal

modules.name: Team Discussion Forum
modules.description:
Only students enrolled in the team can view or participate in the discussion on this forum.

Teams MUST use this forum as a resource to monitor, plan, and upload documents for all team assessments so the evidence produced in the forum can be used to keep all students productive and accountable.
